---
name: Skill improvement
about: Propose an improvement to an existing skill
title: "[Improvement] "
labels: improvement, triage
assignees: ''
---

## Which skill?

Name the skill (e.g., dealer-aeo-audit, dealer-ga4-tracking-audit).

## What is the gap?

What is missing, wrong, ambiguous, or out of date in the current skill? Cite the specific file (SKILL.md, REFERENCE.md, CHECKS.md, etc.) and the specific section, dimension, or paragraph.

## Proposed improvement

What change do you propose? Be specific:

- Add a new dimension or check
- Adjust a scoring weight
- Expand a prompt set
- Add a platform-specific section (Dealer.com, DealerOn, DealerInspire)
- Add an OEM-specific section
- Update a verification procedure
- Fix a factual error
- Clarify ambiguous language

## Why this is better

Briefly explain why your proposed change improves the skill: more accurate, more comprehensive, easier to execute, better aligned with industry reality.

## Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I will open a pull request
- [ ] I can describe the improvement but cannot write the changes myself

## Anything else?

Open field for context, references, or related material.
